lines.zh: 我每走一步，山谷就响一下。
lines.en: Every step I take, the valley answers.
Trees snap in two beside my feet.

lines.zh: 我拖着巨大的尾巴扫过山脊。
lines.en: My huge tail sweeps the ridge.

lines.zh: 我低头都难，脖子太粗了。
lines.en: I can barely lower my head; my neck is too thick.

lines.zh: 脚掌落下去，湖面都震了。
lines.en: A footfall and the lake shivers.

lines.zh: 我迈过河，河水只到脚踝。
lines.en: I step over the river; it only reaches my ankle.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住整片森林。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole forest.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但没有东西挡得住。
lines.en: I walk slowly, and nothing stops me.

lines.zh: 金毛在阳光下亮得刺眼。
lines.en: My golden fur glares in the sun.

lines.zh: 我把一截树干踩成木屑。
lines.en: I crush a trunk into splinters.

lines.zh: 山脉在我眼里只是一道坎。
lines.en: To me, mountains are just a step.

lines.zh: 我转身，尾巴把石堆扫平了。
lines.en: I turn and my tail levels the rocks.
I stand, fists still clenched.

lines.zh: 云从我的肩膀上飘过去。
lines.en: Clouds drift past my shoulder.
My breathing sounds like thunder.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看不到我的尽头。
lines.en: I look up and can't see my own height.
The forest underfoot quivers.

lines.zh: 我痒，用尾巴蹭了蹭山壁。
lines.en: I itch, so I rub against the cliff.
My golden fur bristles.

lines.zh: 我抬脚又放下，踩塌一片树。
lines.en: I lift a foot and set it down on flattened trees.
Everything here is too small.

lines.zh: 我低头，看到脚下的村庄。
lines.en: I look down at a village at my feet.

lines.zh: 我想不起自己以前的样子。
lines.en: I can't recall what I used to be.

lines.zh: 愤怒让我拳头握得更紧。
lines.en: Anger tightens my fists.

lines.zh: 我等着，等一个能挡住我的东西。
lines.en: I wait for something that can stop me.

lines.zh: 我动了动脖子，骨节咔咔响。
lines.en: I roll my neck and the joints crack.

lines.zh: 你在我的脚边，还没有我的趾甲高。
lines.en: You're at my feet, shorter than my toenail.

lines.zh: 我低头，脖子快贴到地面。
lines.en: I lower my head until my neck nearly touches ground.

lines.zh: 你连我的眼睛都够不到。
lines.en: You can't even reach my eyes.
I see you, little thing.
The way you raise your hands is funny.

lines.zh: 我呼一口气，你就站不稳了。
lines.en: One breath from me and you stagger.

lines.zh: 你会跑吗？我喜欢看猎物跑。
lines.en: Will you run? I like watching prey run.
My eyes are glowing red.
You brought a weapon. Better still.
Head tilted, I look down at you.
One hand could close around you.
I can't make out your shouting.
Your ki is such a thin thread.

lines.zh: 我伸出爪子，指甲比人还长。
lines.en: I extend claws longer than a man.
Don't be scared. I haven't moved yet.
Look up. See how high the sky is.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌就能拍平这座山。
lines.en: One palm could flatten this mountain.
How long will you stand there?

lines.zh: 我痛得吼出来，声音传遍山谷。
lines.en: I bellow, and the valley carries it.

lines.zh: 这一下扎得深，我退了一步。
lines.en: That went deep; I take a step back.
I raise a hand to guard my chest.
Blood mats my golden fur.

lines.zh: 我咬牙，牙齿咬得咯吱响。
lines.en: I grind my teeth.

lines.zh: 这点伤，还不够让我倒下。
lines.en: Not enough to bring me down.
I roar, and the clouds scatter.
Pain makes me want to smash things.
I glance at the wound.

lines.zh: 你伤到我了，记住这一点。
lines.en: You hurt me. Remember that.

lines.zh: 那点东西，连我牙缝都塞不满。
lines.en: That wouldn't fill the gap in my teeth.
I smell food. Very faint.
You hold it too low; I can't see it.
I bend, and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 你不会以为这能喂饱我吧？
lines.en: You don't think that feeds me, do you?

lines.zh: 我一口气就能把你吹倒。
lines.en: One breath and you'd fall over.
Give it here. I'm not picky.
Even a great ape has to eat.

lines.zh: 这么小一块，我一捏就碎了。
lines.en: So small; I'd crush it in one squeeze.

lines.zh: 你退后，别被我一并吞了。
lines.en: Back away, unless you want to be swallowed too.

lines.zh: 你撞在我脚背上，我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: You hit my instep; I barely notice.

lines.zh: 我脚下晃了一下，地裂了。
lines.en: I shift my foot and the ground splits.
You're thrown back a long way.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看，什么也没有。
lines.en: I look down and see nothing.

lines.zh: 这一撞，连蚊子都算不上。
lines.en: That bump wasn't even a mosquito.

lines.zh: 我把脚挪开，免得踩扁你。
lines.en: I move my foot so I don't crush you.
A corner of the cliff collapses where I hit it.
I hope your bones held.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，整片林子都在响。
lines.en: I step back and the whole wood rings.
Move; I'm turning around.

lines.zh: 同族的声音很低，像远处的雷。
lines.en: Another of my kind sounds low, like distant thunder.
We regard each other across two mountains.
Its gold is darker than mine.
We beat our chests together.

lines.zh: 声音撞在一起，山都在抖。
lines.en: The sounds collide and the hills shake.

lines.zh: 这片大陆够我们两个分。
lines.en: This continent is enough for both of us.

lines.zh: 我们并肩坐下，森林消失了。
lines.en: We sit side by side, and the forest vanishes.
It leaves first, leaving lake-sized prints.

lines.zh: 我留在原地，看着它走远。
lines.en: I stay and watch it go.

lines.zh: 下次见面，也许就是敌人。
lines.en: Next time we meet, we may be enemies.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，抓起一整棵树。
lines.en: I bend and uproot a whole tree.

lines.zh: 手里的东西太小，我怕捏碎。
lines.en: Things are too small; I fear crushing them.
This weighs like a feather.
I toss it into my mouth.

lines.zh: 树根还带着土，我不在意。
lines.en: Roots still muddy; I don't care.
I squeeze; it's hard as stone.
I hold it up and block the sun.
I carry off an entire copse.
What I held scatters on the ground.
You moved. That counts as starting.
I turn, and the ground sways with me.
This great ape hide is too thick.
I raise a hand and the shadow falls.
First I flatten you, then we talk.
My eyes brighten.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉，我一步就到了。
lines.en: You can't escape; one step is enough.
Ki gathers in my mouth.
A Dead Ball forms in my palm.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，整片林子静了。
lines.en: I roar, and the whole wood goes silent.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，马上就没有了。
lines.en: Where you stand won't exist shortly.
Don't bother hiding; I see your heat.
One stomp and it's over.
Run. Make it last.
I stride across two ridges.
You run on the ground like a bug.
I see every step you take.
A Dead Ball is wasted on you.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍下去，你跳开了。
lines.en: I slam a palm down; you leap clear.
I crush half a forest.
Hiding behind a tree won't work.
Every step brings me closer.
A ki blast grazes my shoulder.
It doesn't hurt. It just makes me angrier.
I reach up into the clouds.
You run inside my shadow.
I beat my chest like a drum.
How much longer can you last?
There's no ground left to stand on.
Everything here is mine to trample.
Don't stop. Stopping means I see you.
Never mind. Fight first.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌扫过去，树全倒了。
lines.en: One palm sweep and the trees go down.

lines.zh: 拳头砸下去，地面凹成坑。
lines.en: My fist falls and the ground becomes a pit.
I lift my foot and stomp.
My tail lashes and the cliff splits.
The Dead Ball leaves my palm.
The wind of my punch knocks you over.
I grab you and press you to the ground.

lines.zh: 这一击，连我自己都听见了。
lines.en: Even I heard that blow.
You actually survived.
Good. Again.
I beat my chest louder.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，气从牙缝喷出来。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and ki hisses out.
You struggle in my palm.
I fling you away.
I trample a whole patch of ground.
Stay still. Stop dodging.

lines.zh: 我从天边落下来，地面塌了。
lines.en: I drop from the sky and the ground caves.
I scatter the clouds.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比树还高得多。
lines.en: I rise, far taller than the trees.
My golden fur ripples in the wind.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，只听见自己的回声。
lines.en: I roar, and only my own echo answers.
Everything underfoot is broken.
I only know I'm furious.
The ki around here is so weak.
I raise a hand and block the sun.
Mountains are steps beneath me.
I step down, and the river changes course.
Someone is shouting; I don't understand.
The sound carries far.
Send me something worth fighting.
I stand here, waiting.
Begin.

lines.zh: 火在我毛上烧，像点了一把干草。
lines.en: Fire spreads through my fur like dry grass.

lines.zh: 我落地时，整片山谷都塌了。
lines.en: When I land, the whole valley sinks.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我拼命抬头。
lines.en: Water floods my throat; I fight to raise my head.

lines.zh: 爆炸在我脚边炸开，像烟花。
lines.en: The blast blooms at my feet like fireworks.

lines.zh: 一根长矛扎进肩上，像根刺。
lines.en: A spear sticks in my shoulder like a splinter.

lines.zh: 光缠上我的手臂，我甩不掉。
lines.en: Light wraps my arm and I can't shake it.

lines.zh: 我饿得站不稳，肚子在响。
lines.en: Hunger makes me sway; my belly growls.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我头上，我晃了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my head and I sway.

lines.zh: 我掉进黑里，什么都看不见。
lines.en: I fall into blackness and see nothing.
